listenings.text: Hello, this is Claire. A short note about last month. The numbers were not good in Europe: the average delay was five days, and two countries were not on target. Brazil was the exception. Your delay was two days, and your cost was on target. I was very happy with that. Thank you, and see you in the next forum.

Hi, this is Marcos. About the problem last week: the truck was at the gate on Tuesday, but the documents were not ready. It was not the driver's fault, and it was not our fault either. The papers were with the customs office. Everything is fine now, but the delivery was two days late. Sorry about that.

extra_audio.text: Last month the material from India was ten days late. The tanks in the plant were empty. The production line was stopped for one day. Then the delivery was here on Monday. The last two weeks were easy, and every order was ready on time.

paras: This is the summary of the September meeting. Last month was a difficult month for the plant.
In the first two weeks the team was very busy. There were two problems with the machines, and the line was stopped for one day.
The reason was simple: the new material from India was ten days late, and the tanks were empty. It was not our fault.
The last two weeks were easy. The material was here on Monday, the line was fast, and every order was ready on time.
